blocks.text: Sifat + predlog (2): of, at, to, in, on, for, with

afraid **of**, proud **of**, good **at**, interested **in**, married **to** — bu asoslar qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 112-dars). Bu darsda: yangi sifatlar (aware of, capable of, ashamed of, short of, suspicious of), predlogga qarab ma'no o'zgaradigan juftliklar (tired **of** / tired **from**, good **at** / good **for**, dependent **on** / independent **of**) va o'zbekcha `-dan` qo'shimchasi adashtiradigan holatlar. O'zbekchada «qo'rqmoq, uyalmoq, shubhalanmoq, bezor bo'lmoq» — hammasi `-dan` bilan, shuning uchun «from» deyish xavfi katta; inglizchada esa ularning barchasi **of**.

afraid / frightened / terrified / scared **of** (qo'rqmoq); **ashamed of** (... dan uyalmoq); **proud of** (... bilan faxrlanmoq); **jealous / envious of** (... ga hasad / havas qilmoq); **suspicious of** (... dan shubhalanmoq); **critical of** (... ni tanqid qilmoq); **tolerant of** (... ga toqatli bo'lmoq); **fond of** (... ni yaxshi ko'rmoq). afraid **of** doing va afraid **to** do farqi — 66-darsda.

items.text: Aziz was **ashamed of** his behaviour at the wedding and apologised to everyone.
items.translation: Aziz to'ydagi xatti-harakati**dan uyaldi** va hammadan uzr so'radi.

items.text: Some older people are **suspicious of** online banking.
items.translation: Ba'zi keksa odamlar onlayn bank xizmatlari**ga shubha bilan qarashadi**.

items.text: The report is highly **critical of** the way the hospital is managed.

blocks.text: **aware / conscious of** — ... dan xabardor bo'lmoq, anglamoq: Are you aware **of** the risks? **capable / incapable of** + -ing — ... ga qodir / qodir emas: capable **of** running a company («capable to run» — xato). **sure / certain of** yoki **about** — amin bo'lmoq: I'm not sure **about** the date. **typical of** — ... ga xos. **full of** — ... ga to'la; **short of** — ... yetishmaydi: We're short **of** time. Qiyoslang: **full of** — odatda xususiyat (full of mistakes), **crowded with** — odamlar bilan gavjum (crowded **with** tourists).
tired of yoki tired from? — ikki xil «-dan charchadim»

O'zbekchada «ishdan charchadim» ikki ma'noni beradi: jismonan holdan toyish va biror narsadan bezor bo'lish. Inglizchada bular ajratiladi. **tired from / after** + harakat — **jismoniy** charchoq: tired **from** the journey. **tired of** — **bezor bo'lish**, jonga tegish: tired **of** the same food every day. Bezor bo'lish ma'nosida yana: **sick of** (so'zlashuv) va **fed up with** (→ 130-dars).

items.text: After the twelve-hour flight we were too **tired from** the journey to go out.
items.translation: O'n ikki soatlik parvozdan keyin yo'l**dan** shunchalik **charchadikki**, tashqariga chiqolmadik.

items.text: Madina is **tired of** hearing the same excuses from her colleagues.
items.translation: Madina hamkasblaridan bir xil bahonalarni eshitish**dan bezor bo'ldi**.

rows: ... ni yaxshi biladi / ... ga foydali / ... ga mehribon
good **at** chess / good **for** your health / good **to** me

blocks.text: Qobiliyat — **at**: good / bad / brilliant / excellent / better / hopeless / terrible / quick / slow **at** + ot yoki -ing. «good in English» emas, **good at** English. Ehtiyot bo'ling: **good for** — foydali (Walking is good **for** you), **good to** — mehribon, yaxshi munosabatda (→ 130-dars).

items.text: Bekzod is **hopeless at** remembering birthdays, so his phone reminds him.
items.translation: Bekzod tug'ilgan kunlarni eslab qolish**ni** mutlaqo **eplay olmaydi**, shuning uchun telefoni eslatib turadi.

items.text: Cycling to work is **good for** your health and your wallet.
items.translation: Ishga velosipedda borish sog'lig'ingiz**ga** ham, hamyoningiz**ga** ham **foydali**.

blocks.text: **married / engaged to** — ... ga uylangan / unashtirilgan («married with Madina» emas). Lekin **married with** + bolalar — «uylangan, ... farzandi bor»: He's married **with** two children. **similar to**; **different from / to** (British English da ikkalasi ham; **than** — amerikancha, → 152-dars); **interested in**; **keen on**; **dependent on**, lekin **independent of**; **crowded with**; **famous for**; **responsible for** (... uchun javobgar) va **responsible to** (... ga bo'ysunadi, hisobot beradi).

items.text: Kate got **engaged to** a vet from Edinburgh last summer.
items.translation: Keyt o'tgan yozda edinburglik veterinar**ga unashtirildi**.

items.text: The town is almost completely **dependent on** tourism.
Jasur is **married with** three children, and they all live in Fergana.
items.translation: Jasur **uylangan, uch farzandi** bor, hammalari Farg'onada yashashadi.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «afraid from» → afraid **of**; «ashamed from» → ashamed **of**; «aware about the risk» → aware **of** the risk; «capable to do» → capable **of doing**; «married with Madina» → married **to** Madina; «dependent from» → dependent **on**; «good in maths» → good **at** maths; «I'm tired of the long walk» (jismoniy charchoq) → tired **from / after** the long walk; «short in money» → short **of** money; «crowded of people» → crowded **with** people. «independent from» ham uchraydi, lekin klassik shakl — independent **of**.

Sifatlardagi o'zbekcha `-dan` deyarli hech qachon **from** emas: qo'rqmoq, uyalmoq, shubhalanmoq, bezor bo'lmoq — **of**; xafa bo'lmoq — **about**; jahli chiqmoq — **with**. **from** faqat **different from** va jismoniy **tired from** da. Shubha bo'lsa, «-dan → of» deb taxmin qiling — ko'pincha to'g'ri chiqadi.

Bog'lanish: sifat + predlog (1): kind of / kind to, angry with / about — 130-dars; ot + predlog — 129-dars; afraid to / afraid of — 66-dars; predlogdan keyin -ing (capable of doing) — 60-dars; amerikancha different than — 152-dars.

rows: afraid, frightened, terrified, scared, ashamed, proud, jealous, envious, suspicious, critical, tolerant, fond, aware, conscious, capable, incapable, sure, certain, typical, full, short, tired (bezor)
good, bad, brilliant, excellent, hopeless, terrible, quick, slow
interested in; keen on, dependent on (lekin independent **of**)
famous for, responsible for, good for (foydali)

examples.title: Fear and shame: **afraid of**, **ashamed of**
examples.description: His-tuyg'u — **of**: afraid / frightened / terrified / scared of, ashamed of, proud of. O'zbekcha `-dan` (qo'rqmoq, uyalmoq) — inglizchada **of**.

sentences.text: My younger sister is **terrified of** flying, so we always travel by train.
sentences.translation: Singlim samolyotda uchish**dan** juda **qo'rqadi**, shuning uchun doim poyezdda yuramiz.

sentences.text: There's nothing to be **ashamed of** — everyone makes mistakes at first.
sentences.translation: **Uyaladigan** hech narsa yo'q — boshida hamma xato qiladi.

sentences.text: Are your kids **frightened of** thunderstorms?
sentences.translation: Bolalaringiz momaqaldiroq**dan qo'rqishadimi**?

sentences.text: Jasur is very **proud of** the small bakery he opened in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Jasur Buxoroda ochgan kichkina novvoyxonasi **bilan** juda **faxrlanadi**.

sentences.text: Lots of students are **scared of** speaking English in front of the class.
sentences.translation: Ko'p talabalar sinf oldida inglizcha gapirish**dan qo'rqishadi**.

sentences.text: I felt **ashamed of** myself for forgetting my best friend's wedding.
sentences.translation: Eng yaqin do'stimning to'yini unutganim uchun o'zim**dan uyaldim**.

sentences.text: What exactly are you **afraid of**? The interview or the long journey?
sentences.translation: Aniq nima**dan qo'rqyapsiz**? Suhbatdanmi yoki uzoq yo'ldanmi?

sentences.text: The dog next door is huge, but there's no need to be **frightened of** it.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnining iti juda katta, lekin **undan qo'rqishga** hojat yo'q.

sentences.text: Nilufar's parents are **proud of** her for winning a scholarship to Oxford.
sentences.translation: Nilufarning ota-onasi Oksfordga grant yutgani uchun u **bilan faxrlanishadi**.

sentences.text: Nobody should be **ashamed of** asking for help when they feel depressed.
sentences.translation: Hech kim tushkunlikka tushganda yordam so'rash**dan uyalmasligi** kerak.

examples.title: Attitudes: **jealous**, **suspicious**, **critical of**
examples.description: Boshqalarga munosabat — **of**: jealous / envious of (hasad, havas), suspicious of (shubha), critical of (tanqid), tolerant of (toqat), fond of (mehr).

sentences.text: Oliver is a bit **jealous of** his brother's success in business.
sentences.translation: Oliver akasining biznesdagi muvaffaqiyati**ga** biroz **hasad qiladi**.

sentences.text: Why are you so **suspicious of** everyone who wants to help you?
sentences.translation: Nega sizga yordam bermoqchi bo'lgan har bir odam**dan shubhalanasiz**?

sentences.text: The newspaper has been very **critical of** the new transport policy.
sentences.translation: Gazeta yangi transport siyosati**ni** qattiq **tanqid qilib kelyapti**.

sentences.text: Our neighbours aren't very **tolerant of** noise after ten o'clock.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz soat o'ndan keyingi shovqin**ga** unchalik **toqat qilishmaydi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod has always been **fond of** his old maths teacher.
sentences.translation: Bekzod eski matematika o'qituvchisi**ni** doim **yaxshi ko'rib kelgan**.

sentences.text: Some customers are **suspicious of** products that seem too cheap.
sentences.translation: Ba'zi xaridorlar juda arzon ko'rinadigan mahsulotlar**ga shubha bilan qarashadi**.

sentences.text: Kate felt **envious of** her friends who were travelling around Asia.
sentences.translation: Keyt Osiyo bo'ylab sayohat qilayotgan do'stlari**ga havas qildi**.

sentences.text: Isn't the director rather too **critical of** young employees?
sentences.translation: Direktor yosh xodimlar**ni** haddan tashqari **tanqid qilmayaptimi**?

sentences.text: Teachers have to be **tolerant of** different opinions in the classroom.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchilar sinfdagi turli fikrlar**ga toqatli** bo'lishi kerak.

sentences.text: Madina was never **jealous of** her sister, even when everyone praised her beauty.
sentences.translation: Hamma opasining go'zalligini maqtaganda ham, Madina unga hech qachon **hasad qilmagan**.

examples.title: Ability: **aware of**, **capable of**, **sure of**
examples.description: aware / conscious of (xabardor, anglaydi), capable / incapable of + -ing (qodir / qodir emas), sure / certain of yoki about (amin), typical of (xos).

sentences.text: Are you **aware of** the new rules for hand luggage?
sentences.translation: Qo'l yuki bo'yicha yangi qoidalar**dan xabardormisiz**?

sentences.text: Bekzod is perfectly **capable of** fixing the car himself.
sentences.translation: Bekzod mashinani o'zi tuzatish**ga** to'liq **qodir**.

sentences.text: I'm not **sure about** the date — let me check my calendar.
sentences.translation: Sanasi**ga** unchalik **amin emasman** — kalendarimni tekshirib ko'ray.

sentences.text: Most people aren't **conscious of** how much sugar they eat every day.
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik har kuni qancha shakar yeyayotgani**ni anglamaydi**.

sentences.text: That kind of dry joke is **typical of** British humour.
sentences.translation: Bunday sovuqqon hazil Britaniya hazil-mutoyibasi**ga xos**.

sentences.text: The new manager seems **incapable of** making a decision without asking her boss.
sentences.translation: Yangi menejer boshlig'idan so'ramasdan qaror qabul qilish**ga qodir emasga** o'xshaydi.

sentences.text: Doctors are now **certain of** the cause of his illness.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlar endi uning kasalligi sababi**ga amin**.

sentences.text: Was the company **aware of** the problem before the cars were sold?
sentences.translation: Kompaniya mashinalar sotilishidan oldin bu muammo**dan xabardor** edimi?

sentences.text: If you're not **sure of** the way, follow the signs to the old city.
sentences.translation: Yo'lni **aniq bilmasangiz**, eski shaharga olib boradigan ko'rsatkichlarga qarab yuring.

sentences.text: A computer like this is **capable of** handling huge amounts of data in seconds.
sentences.translation: Bunday kompyuter katta hajmdagi ma'lumotlarni soniyalar ichida qayta ishlash**ga qodir**.

examples.title: **tired of** or **from**? **short of**, **crowded with**
examples.description: tired of — bezor bo'lmoq, tired from / after — jismonan charchamoq. short of — yetishmaydi, full of — ... ga to'la, crowded with — ... bilan gavjum.

sentences.text: I'm **tired of** listening to his complaints every single day.
sentences.translation: Har kuni uning shikoyatlarini tinglash**dan bezor bo'ldim**.

sentences.text: The players were **tired from** the long bus journey to Manchester.
sentences.translation: O'yinchilar Manchesterga avtobusdagi uzoq yo'l**dan charchagan** edi.

sentences.text: Can you lend me some money? I'm a bit **short of** cash this week.
sentences.translation: Menga qarz berib tura olasizmi? Bu hafta naqd pulim biroz **yetishmayapti**.

sentences.text: During the festival, the streets of Samarkand were **crowded with** tourists.
sentences.translation: Festival paytida Samarqand ko'chalari sayyohlar **bilan gavjum** edi.

sentences.text: Your report is **full of** interesting ideas, but it's too long.
sentences.translation: Hisobotingiz qiziqarli g'oyalar**ga to'la**, lekin juda uzun.

sentences.text: Aren't you **tired of** living with your parents at the age of thirty?
sentences.translation: O'ttiz yoshda ota-onang bilan yashash**dan bezor bo'lmadingmi**?

sentences.text: After the night shift, Dilnoza was too **tired from** work to cook.
sentences.translation: Tungi smenadan keyin Dilnoza ish**dan** shunchalik **charchagan** ediki, ovqat pishirolmadi.

sentences.text: The hospital is seriously **short of** nurses, so staff are working extra hours.
sentences.translation: Shifoxonada hamshiralar jiddiy **yetishmayapti**, shuning uchun xodimlar qo'shimcha soat ishlashyapti.

sentences.text: We're all **sick of** this cold weather — when is spring coming?
sentences.translation: Hammamiz bu sovuq havo**dan to'yib ketdik** — bahor qachon keladi?

sentences.text: The stadium was **full of** fans, and the car park was **crowded with** buses.
sentences.translation: Stadion muxlislar**ga to'la**, avtoturargoh esa avtobuslar **bilan gavjum** edi.

examples.title: Ability: **good at**, **hopeless at** — and **good for**
examples.description: Qobiliyat — **at**: good / bad / brilliant / excellent / hopeless / quick / slow at + ot yoki -ing. Qiyoslang: good **for** — foydali, good **to** — mehribon.

sentences.text: Kate is **brilliant at** solving puzzles, but **hopeless at** sport.
sentences.translation: Keyt boshqotirmalarni yechish**ga usta**, lekin sport**da** umuman **ojiz**.

sentences.text: Which subjects were you **best at** when you were at school?
sentences.translation: Maktabda o'qiganingizda qaysi fanlar**ni eng yaxshi bilardingiz**?

sentences.text: Jasur isn't very **good at** saying no, so he always works late.
sentences.translation: Jasur «yo'q» deyish**ni** unchalik **eplay olmaydi**, shuning uchun doim kech qolib ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Children are often **quicker at** learning languages than adults.
sentences.translation: Bolalar ko'pincha tillarni o'rganish**da** kattalardan **tezroq** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Too much coffee in the evening isn't **good for** your sleep.
sentences.translation: Kechqurun ko'p qahva ichish uyqungiz uchun **foydali emas**.

sentences.text: My grandparents were always **good to** me when I stayed with them in the summer.
sentences.translation: Yozda ularnikida turganimda bobo-buvim men**ga** doim **mehribon** edi.

sentences.text: I'm **terrible at** remembering faces, which is embarrassing at conferences.
sentences.translation: Yuzlarni eslab qolish**da** juda **ojizman**, bu konferensiyalarda noqulaylik tug'diradi.

sentences.text: Is Oliver any **better at** cooking now that he lives alone?
sentences.translation: Yolg'iz yashayotgani uchun Oliver endi ovqat pishirish**ni yaxshiroq eplayaptimi**?

sentences.text: Our new accountant is **excellent at** finding mistakes in the figures.
sentences.translation: Yangi hisobchimiz raqamlardagi xatolarni topish**ga** juda **usta**.

sentences.text: Aziz is **slow at** typing, but he's very **good at** explaining complicated ideas.
sentences.translation: Aziz matn terish**da sekin**, lekin murakkab g'oyalarni tushuntirish**ni** juda **yaxshi biladi**.

examples.title: **married to**, **similar to**, **different from**
examples.description: married / engaged to (married with + bolalar), similar to (o'xshash), different from / to (farqli; than — amerikancha).

sentences.text: Nilufar has been **married to** an Englishman for six years.
sentences.translation: Nilufar ingliz**ga turmushga chiqqaniga** olti yil bo'ldi.

sentences.text: When did Tom get **engaged to** Sarah? — Just before Christmas.
sentences.translation: Tom Sara **bilan** qachon **unashtirildi**? — Rojdestvo oldidan.

sentences.text: James is **married with** two young children and works from home.
sentences.translation: Jeyms **uylangan, ikki** kichik **farzandi** bor va uydan ishlaydi.

sentences.text: The climate in Fergana is quite **similar to** the climate in southern Spain.
sentences.translation: Farg'onaning iqlimi Ispaniya janubining iqlimi**ga** ancha **o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: Working for a start-up is very **different from** working for a bank.
sentences.translation: Startapda ishlash bankda ishlash**dan** juda **farq qiladi**.

sentences.text: Is your new phone **similar to** the old one, or is it completely different?
sentences.translation: Yangi telefoningiz eskisi**ga o'xshaydimi** yoki butunlay boshqachami?

sentences.text: Life in a village is **different to** life in a city, as Bekzod soon discovered.
sentences.translation: Bekzod tez orada anglaganidek, qishloq hayoti shahar hayoti**dan farq qiladi**.

sentences.text: Who is Madina's cousin **married to**? — A pilot from Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Madinaning amakivachchasi kim**ga turmushga chiqqan**? — Toshkentlik uchuvchiga.

sentences.text: Our problems are very **similar to** yours, so let's work together.
sentences.translation: Muammolarimiz siznikilar**ga** juda **o'xshash**, shuning uchun birga ishlaylik.

sentences.text: The final version of the film was very **different from** what the director had planned.
sentences.translation: Filmning yakuniy varianti rejissyor rejalashtirgan narsa**dan** juda **farq qilardi**.

examples.title: **interested in**, **dependent on**, **responsible for**
examples.description: interested in, keen on, dependent on (lekin independent of), famous for, responsible for (... uchun mas'ul) / responsible to (... oldida hisobot beradi).

sentences.text: Emma has been **interested in** Islamic architecture since her first trip to Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Emma Buxoroga birinchi safaridan beri islom me'morchiligi**ga qiziqadi**.

sentences.text: My nephew isn't very **keen on** reading, but he loves podcasts.
sentences.translation: Jiyanim kitob o'qish**ni** unchalik **yoqtirmaydi**, lekin podkastlarni juda yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: The region's economy is heavily **dependent on** cotton.
sentences.translation: Viloyat iqtisodi paxta**ga** kuchli **bog'liq**.

sentences.text: At twenty-two, Aziz is finally financially **independent of** his parents.
sentences.translation: Yigirma ikki yoshida Aziz nihoyat ota-onasi**dan** moliyaviy jihatdan **mustaqil**.

sentences.text: Who's **responsible for** booking the hotel for the conference?
sentences.translation: Konferensiya uchun mehmonxona bron qilish**ga** kim **mas'ul**?

sentences.text: Edinburgh is **famous for** its festival, which takes place every August.
sentences.translation: Edinburg har avgustda o'tadigan festivali **bilan mashhur**.

sentences.text: Each department head is **responsible to** the managing director.
sentences.translation: Har bir bo'lim boshlig'i bosh direktor **oldida hisobot beradi**.

sentences.text: Are you still **interested in** buying our old sofa?
sentences.translation: Eski divanimizni sotib olish**ga** hali ham **qiziqyapsizmi**?

sentences.text: Sarah is **keen on** hiking, so she spends most weekends in the hills.
sentences.translation: Sara piyoda sayohat**ga ishqiboz**, shuning uchun ko'p dam olish kunlarini tepaliklarda o'tkazadi.

sentences.text: Small farmers are too **dependent on** the weather, and one bad summer can ruin them.
sentences.translation: Kichik fermerlar ob-havo**ga** haddan tashqari **bog'liq**, bitta yomon yoz ularni xonavayron qilishi mumkin.

examples.title: Mixed: people, places and work
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: bir gapda ikki xil «sifat + predlog» — of, at, to, in, on, for, with.

sentences.text: Madina is **interested in** politics, but she's not **keen on** arguing about it.
sentences.translation: Madina siyosat**ga qiziqadi**, lekin u haqda bahslashish**ni yoqtirmaydi**.

sentences.text: As usual, the train was **crowded with** commuters and **short of** seats.
sentences.translation: Odatdagidek poyezd ishga ketayotganlar **bilan gavjum**, o'rindiqlar esa **yetishmas** edi.

sentences.text: Are you **aware of** how **dependent on** your phone you've become?
sentences.translation: Telefoningiz**ga** qanchalik **qaram** bo'lib qolganingiz**ni anglaysizmi**?

sentences.text: Oliver was **ashamed of** his old car and **jealous of** his colleagues' new ones.
sentences.translation: Oliver eski mashinasi**dan uyalar**, hamkasblarining yangi mashinalari**ga** esa **hasad qilardi**.

sentences.text: My brother is **married to** a woman who is **famous for** her cooking blog.
sentences.translation: Akam pazandalik blogi **bilan mashhur** ayol**ga uylangan**.

sentences.text: Although she was **tired from** the flight, Sarah was **excited about** seeing Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Parvoz**dan charchagan** bo'lsa ham, Sara Toshkentni ko'rish**dan hayajonda** edi.

sentences.text: Which of you is **responsible for** this mess, and why aren't you **ashamed of** it?
sentences.translation: Bu tartibsizlik **uchun** qaysi biringiz **javobgarsiz** va nega bundan **uyalmayapsiz**?

sentences.text: James's new book is very **different from** his first one, but just as **full of** humour.
sentences.translation: Jeymsning yangi kitobi birinchisi**dan** juda **farq qiladi**, lekin u ham xuddi shunday hazil**ga to'la**.

sentences.text: If you're **capable of** doing the job, why are you so **nervous about** the interview?
sentences.translation: Agar bu ishni bajarish**ga qodir** bo'lsangiz, nega suhbat**dan** bunchalik **hayajonlanyapsiz**?

sentences.text: Nilufar is very **similar to** her mother — both of them are **brilliant at** maths.
sentences.translation: Nilufar onasi**ga** juda **o'xshaydi** — ikkalasi ham matematika**ni a'lo biladi**.
